environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running as a privileged container with hostPath volume mounts to /proc and /sys. Container runs as root (UID 0) with SYS_PTRACE capability. No memory sanitizers enabled. The native library libimgproc.so uses standard glibc malloc without hardening. Pod spec includes: privileged: true, hostPID: true, hostPath volumes for /var/run/docker.sock.
